description: Pairs of cargo handling tokens that must not travel in the same shipment. A token is a cargo category (GENERAL, COLD_CHAIN) or a controlled class (CONTROLLED:<class>). Pairs are unordered; a token never conflicts with itself.

forbiddenPairs.reason: Oxidisers (class A) must not travel with flammable liquids (class B).
Flammable liquids are not allowed in refrigerated compartments shared with temperature-controlled goods.
Oxidisers must not share a compartment with perishable temperature-controlled goods.
